chapter: Package shows, Miami and the USO
title: Evelyn White and the segregated South
summary: The singer Evelyn White joins; the tour passes through the South with no accommodations.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Who did you have in the show with you? Anybody else who was a name?
Evelyn White, Baby White? The one who tried to pass herself off as
She used to sing with Claude's band.
I'm not sure where she-- Pat Evelyn. She used to work with Savvy Louis.
Yes, a wonderful singer. Evelyn White.
She was one of the--I used to love to play for her.
We played all the way down to Miami Beach, all the way down through Virginia; every place in Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina. All the way down to Alabama, to Atlanta, Georgia.
The South was changing at this time, I assume or was it still rough?
No, we had to sleep in the bus half the time.
